---

One page per task, each built from the standard task report and computed
from the pinned release: deployment and forms, coverage, the item bank,
item health, scores, reliability, stability and validity, and time,
followed by a section specific to the task and its open issues. For tasks
calibrated separately in each language (Vocabulary, ROAR-Phoneme, ROAR-Word), the
item sections are per language. Longer analyses of particular tasks (for
example Stories, Same & Different scoring and ROAR-Word engagement) are in
[Studies](../studies/index.qmd) and linked from each page's open issues.
